title: Attachment — AgentTune ECR-R adaptation
instructions: Choose the response that best describes you. Answer every item; scores describe this adaptation and are not a diagnosis. Review any suggested communication preferences before using them.
adaptations: Preserves the previous AgentTune website wording, display order, keys and response anchors. This is a versioned AgentTune adaptation, not an unmodified publisher edition.
The four category labels use a heuristic midpoint split at 4; a value of exactly 4 falls on the low side. Continuous scores remain primary.

items.text: I'm afraid that I will lose my partner's love.
